# Daiichi Travel (daiichitravel.com)

> Official platform for transport & cruises between Hanoi, Hai Phong, Cat Ba Island and Lan Ha Bay (Vietnam). Books limousine buses, speedboats, day cruises, 5-star overnight cruises and package tours. Languages: vi, en, ja, ko, zh, fr. Currency: VND. All prices include VAT unless noted.

## Key facts
- Routes: Hanoi ⇄ Cat Ba (3–3.5h, from 270,000₫ incl. speedboat), Hanoi ⇄ Hai Phong (2h, from 140,000₫), Ha Long/Cat Ba ⇄ Ninh Binh, Cat Ba ⇄ Hai Phong (EV + ferry).
- Day cruises on Lan Ha Bay: 6 tours, 400,000–850,000₫/person (seasonal). Seafood lunch on VIP tours.
- Overnight: Daiichi Luxury Cruise, 32 balcony suites, 2,860,000–7,280,000₫/cabin. 12% off booking 30 days ahead (EARLYBIRD12).
- Seasons: high = 09 May–02 Sep 2026; low = 03 Sep 2026–02 May 2027. Holiday surcharge 30,000₫/pax/way.
- Free cancellation up to 12h before departure. Free pickup: Hanoi Old Quarter, central Cat Ba, Hai Phong ≤15km.
- Support 24/7: +84 96 100 4709 (Zalo/WhatsApp), info@daiichitravel.vn.
